title: Project configuration provenance across tsconfig, verterrc and vite

expectedResults.expectation: the @ui/* tsconfig paths mapping and the vite @ui alias resolve to one shared src/ui provenance fact, not two unrelated facts
the viteConfig trust state pinned is carried into the project configuration identity; an unpinned config surfaces as an explicit completeness state, never silent execution
the alias set consumed for build interoperability equals the union of tsconfig paths and vite aliases with conflicts between them flagged
